importantFindings.title: 'Riapri l'app' is a plain reload: one tap during the slow check after it defers the switch again, and the hands-off path costs two reloads
importantFindings.evidence: The reopen state's button calls window.location.reload(), not resumeBackup(true); after the reload watchFirstTouch starts again. Scratch spec on pixel-7, courses GET delayed 3 s: a tap at 0.3 s defers ('Backup pronto…', loads 1); 'Riapri l'app' then a tap 1 s after the load: still deferred (loads 2); hands off: connected after two more loads (loads 4). 'Backup pronto' shows only in Impostazioni.
importantFindings.reproduction: Scratch spec r3a 'R3 the reopen race' (pixel). Expected: after 'Riapri l'app' the switch completes. Observed: deferred again by the first tap, or two reloads when hands off.

qolFindings.title: During the launch check a signed-in phone shows the sign-in form
qolFindings.evidence: current starts as { kind: 'signed-out' } until resumeBackup resolves; with a token refresh slowed to 6 s Impostazioni shows the email form at 0.5 s and 2 s, the account at 8 s. Pre-existing, not a regression.
